name: RacingBoard
description: 📈 Real-time money-flow board for horse, greyhound & harness racing — tote pool share, Betfair weight of money, firmers & drifters. Live WebSocket dashboard + static replay demo.

paragraphs: Status, September 2026: GitHub Actions are currently paused on this repo, so automated data refreshes and deploys are not running. The data and any live site reflect the last build.

A Bloomberg-style live terminal for racing money flow across Thoroughbred, Greyhound & Harness — it surfaces the runners shortening in price (money coming in), gives a recommended pick per race that updates live, and shows a fair price (de-vigged) with the value edge of the best available book price.

Per runner: tote pool share + how much it's shortening · ✓✓/✓✓✓ cross-source confirmation (how many of tote · Betfair · Betr agree it's shortening) · ⚡ live momentum (moving now) · fair price (de-vigged Betfair·tote) · value vs best book · Sportsbet/Pointsbet/Betfair prices · click-to-expand form (comment, jockey, barrier, best time…) · tipster picks + 🎯 Sportsbet expert best-bets · results once run. A signal scorecard grades the pick / ✓ confirmed / value bets vs the result (win/place % vs the favourite baseline, persisted across sessions), and a 🔔 alert fires on strong multi-market steam.…

requirements.text: No API keys needed — TAB runs off its public feed, Betfair off public read-only endpoints. (No TAB secrets are used.)
